value.rationale: The motivating paper establishes chaos for unspecified sufficiently large selection strength, which is not operationally quantitative. The explicit broad robust b interval and a>=100 provide a reproducible entropy guarantee; the same natural repeller has a previously unevaluated uniform two-term Lyapunov exponent and an intrinsic special balance b=1/3, quantifying expansion beyond qualitative coding. This is not a generic relabeling of the horseshoe theorem.
